narrationScript: Welcome to Chapter 2.3: Addressing Modes and Instruction Formats in our Computer Architecture course. This chapter explores how processors access data and how instructions are structured. By the end, you'll be able to describe common addressing modes like immediate, direct, and PC-relative. You'll analyze their impact on instruction format, code density, and compiler complexity. And understand the critical trade-offs between complex addressing modes and pipeline simplicity, even designing your own instruction formats.
